chunk_policy: nonoverlapping 254 content WordPieces plus CLS/SEP; all tokens and code-point intervals accounted
refits: Leave each strict-development meeting out; refit PCA and k-means only; fixed pretrained encoder; overlap-training ARI, not held-out prediction
pairwise: Exact identical usable IDs/order and source hashes only. Compare strict raw384/PCA32/PCA64, matched PCA64 versus saved LSA64, and exact same-population inclusive/baseline fits. No winning-model score.
probes: Eight authored synthetic anchor/paraphrase/opposite/boilerplate contrasts; development diagnostics, not an independent benchmark
display: First two PCs of normalized fitted geometry; display-only neighborhood and distance preservation checks; never cluster on 2D coordinates
matching_note: Each PCA32/PCA64 or Ward semantic fit is paired with the saved lexical fit of matching dimension and method. Unreduced 384-dimensional embeddings are compared with the saved primary LSA64 as an explicitly different-dimensional contrast.
additional_diagnostics: Same-meeting and same-observed-parent shares among 15 nearest neighbors; descriptive dependence checks, not null-calibrated tests.
